name: Sophia persistent agent (Sun, Hong, Zhang)
ontology_notes: System 3 wrapper over any LLM System 1/2 stack. Four services. Memory Module is a RAG-backed graph of goals, experiences, and self-assessments. User-Model tracks each user's goals, social relationship, and preferences. Self-Model holds capabilities, terminal creed, and intrinsic state. Hybrid Reward mixes extrinsic task feedback with curiosity, mastery, and coherence. Episodic traces are tuples of goal, context, chain-of-thought, outcome. Prototype persists HTML/Markdown in a Growth-Journal directory. Not a typed companion ontology. No character autobiography, lore, or OOC.

ontology.evidence: Paper §4.1.3 names Memory Module, User Modeling, Self-Model, Hybrid Reward. Memory is RAG on a vector DB plus optional graph. Creed sentences live in Self Model.terminal_creed. Companion lore and relationship-as-phase are absent.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Process-supervised thought search stores only guardian-critiqued ToT nodes (paper §4.1.3). Runtime writes successful traces into an episodic buffer and Growth-Journal files (§5.1.2). No user pin. No refusal of jokes as relationship facts. Intrinsic goals can write during user idle.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Memory Module is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Figure 3 caption, §4.1.3). Forward learning retrieves prior CoT into the next System 2 prompt (§5.1.2, §5.2.3). Recurring API-error and user-stress traces skip re-planning when retrieved.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Self-Model appends capabilities after skill goals (§5.3.2 OCR example). Reflection patches ToT nodes after an episode. No documented delete-on-contradiction for user facts.
supersession.label: inferred

temporal.evidence: Episodic memory is described as timestamped events (§3.1). Prototype streams JSON user activity every five virtual minutes (§5.1.1). 36-hour sandbox run. No last-Tuesday query language.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: User-Model and Self-Model are separate services (§4.1.3). Memory graph is the agent's narrative identity, not the user's. No character vs user vs relationship types for roleplay. Social relationship is a field on the user belief state, not a phase object.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Stress example retrieves the breathing-exercise plan and acts (paper §5.3.2). Relevance triggers action. No skip-a-high-score-hit control for trauma or spoilers.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Guardian LLM checklist prunes unsound ToT nodes for logic and safety (§4.1.3). Stored journal text is not trust-tagged. No filter against persona overwrite by retrieved traces.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Prototype persists all memories, goals, logs, and nightly self-critiques as HTML/Markdown (§5.1.2). No user forget-that. No decay.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Thought search spawns multiple LLM workers. Recurring tasks drop from expensive first-episode CoT to about 3-4 steps, claimed ~80% reduction (Figure 5 right, §5.2.3). No weight updates at runtime. Still retrieve-then-prompt each turn.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Paper HTML has no GitHub. Compact prototype is described, not released. Runtime needs an LLM planner. Intimate on-machine use cannot be verified from a LICENSE.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Conceptual plus sandbox paper. No MCP in https://arxiv.org/html/2512.18202.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Persistent-agent wrapper with narrative identity, user model, and self model. Memory is still RAG into the planner prompt. User vs self is typed. Character vs relationship vs lore is not. Eval is a 36-hour web sandbox of intrinsic tasks, not companion holes.

published_eval.name: Authors' 36-hour offline browser-sandbox pilot (exploratory, not a public bench)
published_eval.claimed_score: Hard-task first-attempt success 20% at T=0 to 60% at T=36h (Figure 4). ~80% fewer CoT steps on recurring tasks from episode 2 (Figure 5). 13 intrinsic tasks in a 12-18h idle window. Abstract also states 40% gain on high-complexity tasks.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Autonomy, goal generation, and reuse of cached reasoning traces in a synthetic web environment with a textual verifier. Not LoCoMo-class companion QA, identity drift, silence, or forget-that.

open_unknowns: Whether the Growth-Journal prototype will be released.
How User-Model social relationship is stored (string vs typed object). Paper names the field, not a schema.
